network.list_interfaces_json: ifconfig -f inet:cidr,inet6:cidr -a | awk 'function flush() {{ if (name != "") {{ printf "%s{{\"ifname\":\"%s\",\"operstate\":\"%s\",\"address\":\"%s\",\"addr_info\":[%s]}}", sep, name, state, mac, addrs; sep = "," }} }} function add(family, cidr) {{ split(cidr, part, "/"); sub(/%.*/, "", part[1]); addrs = addrs (addrs == "" ? "" : ",") sprintf("{{\"family\":\"%s\",\"local\":\"%s\",\"prefixlen\":%d}}", family, part[1], part[2]) }} BEGIN {{ printf "[" }} /^[^ \t]/ {{ flush(); name = $1; sub(/:$/, "", name); state = ($0 ~ /[<,]UP[,>]/) ? "UP" : "DOWN"; mac = ""; addrs = "" }} $1 == "ether" {{ mac = $2 }} $1 == "inet" {{ add("inet", $2) }} $1 == "inet6" {{ add("inet6", $2) }} END {{ flush(); print "]" }}'
network.bridge_create: b=$(ifconfig bridge create) && ifconfig $b name {interface} >/dev/null && sysrc cloned_interfaces+=$b ifconfig_${{b}}_name={interface}
set_static_ip: route -n change default {gateway} || route -n add default {gateway}
ipv4_static: if [ -n {gateway} ]; then sysrc defaultrouter={gateway}; else sysrc -x defaultrouter || true; fi
ipv6_static: if [ -n {ipv6_gateway} ]; then sysrc ipv6_defaultrouter={ipv6_gateway}; else sysrc -x ipv6_defaultrouter || true; fi
network.connection_activate: service netif restart {interface} && service routing restart; resolvconf -u
network.checkpoint_create: d=/var/db/freedomnas/net-checkpoint-$$; mkdir -p $d && cp /etc/rc.conf $d/rc.conf && (cp /etc/resolvconf.conf $d/resolvconf.conf 2>/dev/null || true) && daemon -f sh -c "sleep {rollback_seconds}; d=$d; [ -d $d ] && {{ cp $d/rc.conf /etc/rc.conf && if [ -f $d/resolvconf.conf ]; then cp $d/resolvconf.conf /etc/resolvconf.conf; else rm -f /etc/resolvconf.conf; fi && rm -rf $d && service netif restart && service routing restart; resolvconf -u; }}" && echo $d
network.checkpoint_rollback: d={checkpoint}; [ -d $d ] && {{ cp $d/rc.conf /etc/rc.conf && if [ -f $d/resolvconf.conf ]; then cp $d/resolvconf.conf /etc/resolvconf.conf; else rm -f /etc/resolvconf.conf; fi && rm -rf $d && service netif restart && service routing restart; resolvconf -u; }}
network.list_physical: c=" $(ifconfig -C) "; for n in $(ifconfig -l ether); do d=$(ifconfig -v $n | awk '/drivername:/ {{print $2}}'); case "$c" in *" ${{d%%[0-9]*}} "*) continue;; esac; echo "$n $(ifconfig $n | awk '/hwaddr/ {{h = $2}} /ether/ {{e = $2}} END {{print (h ? h : e)}}') $d"; done
network.names_clear: sysrc -a | awk -F': ' '$1 ~ /^ifconfig_.*_name$/ && $2 ~ /^fnas_lan/ {{print $1}}' | while read v; do sysrc -x $v; done; true
network.connection_rename: for s in '' _ipv6; do v=$(sysrc -n ifconfig_{old_name}$s 2>/dev/null) && sysrc ifconfig_{new_name}$s="$v" && sysrc -x ifconfig_{old_name}$s; done; true
network.bond_create: l=$(ifconfig lagg create) && ifconfig $l name {interface} >/dev/null && sysrc cloned_interfaces+=$l ifconfig_${{l}}_name={interface}
network.vlan_create: v=$(ifconfig vlan create vlan {vlan_id} vlandev {parent}) && ifconfig $v name {interface} >/dev/null && sysrc vlans_{parent}+={interface} create_args_{interface}="vlan {vlan_id}"
network.bond_mode_lacp: ifconfig {interface} laggproto lacp && sysrc ifconfig_{interface}+="laggproto lacp"
network.bond_mode_failover: ifconfig {interface} laggproto failover && sysrc ifconfig_{interface}+="laggproto failover"
network.bridge_port_add: for a in $(ifconfig {port} inet | awk '/inet / {{print $2}}'); do ifconfig {port} inet $a -alias; done; ifconfig {port} up && (ifconfig {interface} | grep -q 'member: {port} ' || ifconfig {interface} addm {port}) && sysrc ifconfig_{port}=up ifconfig_{interface}+="addm {port}" && (sysrc -x ifconfig_{port}_ipv6 2>/dev/null; true)
network.bond_port_add: for a in $(ifconfig {port} inet | awk '/inet / {{print $2}}'); do ifconfig {port} inet $a -alias; done; ifconfig {port} up && (ifconfig {interface} | grep -q 'laggport: {port} ' || ifconfig {interface} laggport {port}) && sysrc ifconfig_{port}=up ifconfig_{interface}+="laggport {port}" && (sysrc -x ifconfig_{port}_ipv6 2>/dev/null; true)
network.mac_set: sysrc -f /boot/loader.conf if_bridge_load=YES >/dev/null && sysctl net.link.bridge.inherit_mac=1 >/dev/null && (grep -q '^net.link.bridge.inherit_mac=1' /etc/sysctl.conf 2>/dev/null || echo net.link.bridge.inherit_mac=1 >> /etc/sysctl.conf) && (ifconfig {interface} ether {mac} 2>/dev/null; true)
network.virtual_activate: a=$(sysrc -n ifconfig_{interface}); case "$a" in *DHCP*) ifconfig {interface} up && dhclient {interface};; *) ifconfig {interface} $(echo "$a" | sed -E 's/(laggproto|laggport|addm) [^ ]+//g') up;; esac; service routing restart; resolvconf -u
network.virtual_delete: c=$(sysrc -a | awk -F': ' '$2 == "'{interface}'" && $1 ~ /^ifconfig_.*_name$/ {{sub(/^ifconfig_/, "", $1); sub(/_name$/, "", $1); print $1}}'); ifconfig {interface} destroy; if [ -n "$c" ]; then sysrc cloned_interfaces-=$c; sysrc -x ifconfig_${{c}}_name; fi; for v in $(sysrc -a -N | grep '^vlans_'); do sysrc $v-={interface}; done; sysrc -x ifconfig_{interface} ifconfig_{interface}_ipv6 create_args_{interface} 2>/dev/null; true
network.routes_set: for r in $(sysrc -n static_routes 2>/dev/null) $(sysrc -n ipv6_static_routes 2>/dev/null); do case $r in rt_{interface}_*) sysrc static_routes-=$r ipv6_static_routes-=$r >/dev/null; sysrc -x route_$r ipv6_route_$r 2>/dev/null;; esac; done; n=0; for spec in {routes}; do n=$((n+1)); case $spec in *:*) sysrc ipv6_static_routes+=rt_{interface}_$n ipv6_route_rt_{interface}_$n="${{spec%%=*}} ${{spec#*=}}";; *) sysrc static_routes+=rt_{interface}_$n route_rt_{interface}_$n="-net ${{spec%%=*}} ${{spec#*=}}";; esac || exit 1; done; true
network.wg_exists: sysrc -n wireguard_interfaces 2>/dev/null | grep -qw {interface} && test -f /usr/local/etc/wireguard/{interface}.conf && echo yes
